candidate: BATCHIE prospective pediatric-cancer combination screen (Tosh et al., Nature Communications 2025; code 'batchie' on GitHub)
evidence_level: public abstract/summary level only (one web search); the full text, the data-availability statement and the data files were NOT opened or downloaded
what_was_learned: 206 drugs on a panel of pediatric cancer cell lines; the design adaptively explored about 4% of ~1.4M possible experiments; validation experiments on selected combinations followed.

criteria_by_observation_structure.C1 outcomes measured for every action a: NOT MET as described: ~96% of the action space is unobserved and the observed 4% was selected by the original adaptive design, so a replayed alternative policy would mostly request unobserved actions
criteria_by_observation_structure.C2 several independent backgrounds with: unknown without the data; the panel is small
criteria_by_observation_structure.C3 released-history vs task split with d: possible only inside the observed, policy-selected subset
criteria_by_observation_structure.C4 no imputation of unobserved actions: required by the protocol; makes C1 binding

decision: NOT QUALIFIED. No external source was used and none was compared. No further dataset was searched for, as instructed.
missing_measured_unit: For each of >= 16-24 independent held-out backgrounds (cell lines/models), measured combination responses (>= duplicate reads, one stated dose/endpoint) for a pre-declared candidate pool of a few hundred drug pairs that is the SAME pool for every policy, plus the monotherapy readouts that define the shared reference; a released-history subset of backgrounds measured before the decisions; the probe/target split fixed in advance.
minimal_design: Fully measure one pool of ~350 pairs (the O'Neil-scale pool used here is 410) on N backgrounds; release the first 8 as history; for the remaining backgrounds let each arm choose <=4 probes and a 5-pair shortlist from a blinded lookup of the pre-measured pool (lookup returns the stored measurement; unlisted actions are impossible); score the realized mean activity of the 5 nominated pairs. N is set by the paired stream-level SD of the effect (see REPORT, power section): with a paired SD of s, detecting a gain of 0.01 at 95% needs about (1.96*s/0.01)^2 additional backgrounds.
note: This is a design statement, not evidence. The internal development replay on the 18 released O'Neil backgrounds (REAL_DEV_REPLAY.json) has the right observation structure but is exposed development data and one world.
